question.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2},$ ${a}_{3},$ and ${a}_{4}$ are given below. Determine whether $B=\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}\}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$ If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3},$ where ${a}_{4}={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -5\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{4}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
We want to determine if $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$ So, we want to find ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}\in R$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+{x}_{2}{{[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}+{x}_{3}{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}={{[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{4}}.
$$

This equation is equivalent to the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-1 \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=2 \\ 5{x}_{1}-5{x}_{2}+6{x}_{3}=2\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we reduce the augmented matrix of the system to reduced row echelon form (RREF):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & -1 \\ -2 & 3 & -2 & 2 \\ 5 & -5 & 6 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & -5 & 6 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-1){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -8 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -8 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From the reduced matrix above, we see that the pivot columns are the $1$st, $2$nd, and $3$rd columns. So,  $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$
Also, the matrix tells us that ${x}_{1}=-8,$ ${x}_{2}=0,$ and ${x}_{3}=7,$ meaning that

$$
(-8)\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+0\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}+7\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}={{[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{4}}.
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-8+0+7=-1.$
